name: Very short waves, kh = kv = 20
setup: Very short waves, kh = kv = 20: about 5 coarse cells per wavelength. Run to t = 3.
expect: Even less resolution than case 19. Expect MCL to flatten the waves almost entirely.
observed: MCL-NN flattens the waves almost completely (minimum h 2.00 vs 1.86 in the DNS): h error 4.1% vs 1.1% for the NN alone. The limiter, not the network, is the failure point here.
